ns2:section.sectionText: Advanced Topics in Biomedical Ultrasound Imaging. This course will introduce students to the advanced and state-of-the-art topics and methods in the field of biomedical ultrasound imaging. At the beginning of the course, we will provide brief reviews of the fundamentals of biomedical ultrasound. We will then move on to advanced topics including advanced beamforming, quantitative ultrasound, elastography, advanced blood flow imaging techniques, advanced 3D ultrasound imaging, and other advanced topics such as super-resolution imaging, molecular imaging and photoacoustic imaging. We will also introduce ultrasound simulation software including Field II and k-wave, which will be use throughout the semester for homework assignments and final project. Prerequisites: ECE 472 or consent of instructor.
